intro: From Zero to Professional Facebook Ads Expert – Learn Meta Ads, AI-Powered Advertising, Pixel, Scaling, and Freelancing.
overview: Practical Facebook Ads Mastery is a complete hands-on offline course specially designed to make you a professional Facebook & Instagram Ads expert. This course covers everything from basic page setup to advanced Meta Ads strategies, AI optimization, pixel tracking, dynamic ads, and real client acquisition from Fiverr & Upwork.

careers.title: Facebook Ads Specialist
careers.text: Run Facebook and Instagram ads to generate leads and sales for businesses. Work as a specialist managing ad campaigns for clients or companies.

careers.title: Meta Ads Manager
careers.text: Fully manage Meta (Facebook + Instagram) advertising accounts. High-demand role with good salary in agencies and large companies.

careers.title: Freelance Digital Marketer (Fiverr & Upwork)
careers.text: Work as a freelancer on international platforms. Manage Facebook ads for global clients and earn attractive income (1 to 5 lakh+ Taka per month possible).

careers.title: E-commerce Ads Expert
careers.text: Specialize in running dynamic product ads and catalog campaigns for online stores. High demand in e-commerce businesses.

careers.title: Digital Marketing Executive
careers.text: Join a company’s digital marketing team and handle Facebook & Instagram advertising along with other digital channels.

careers.title: Performance Marketing Specialist
careers.text: Focus on result-driven marketing with strong emphasis on ROI and ROAS. Analyze and optimize campaigns for maximum performance.

careers.title: Own Digital Marketing Agency Owner
careers.text: Start and grow your own digital marketing agency by serving multiple clients with Facebook and Instagram ad management.
